profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ECS Limited
profile.summary:
Seeking challenging full-time position with opportunities for career development in the fields of engineering and software development. I offer excellent technical abilities in software, hardware, and analytics, and possess a strong desire to improve and develop. I have working experience with Java/JSP development using Hibernate framework and Oracle databases in a project setting. I also have experience with PHP backend development using Symfony and Apigility to build an e-commerce marketplace, as well as experience with C#/Javascript development in a .NET framework. Able to thrive in an Agile group environment and work in a small or large team.

Skills: Analytical thinking, software development, time management, PHP, Symfony, Apigility, Github, C++, C#, Java, Javascript, HTML5, SQL, Oracle, Hibernate, BIRT, Eclipse, Hudson, ISO/FDA, regulated environments

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Microsoft Azure · React.js · .NET Framework · TypeScript

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
- Full-stack development of web applications
- Primary developer on PPD's FSP (Functional Service Partnerships) Source Portal web application
-- Typescript, C#, Entity Framework Core, MySql Server, Swagger/OpenAPI for REST, Azure Pipelines for CI/CD, Evolve migration
- Developer on numerous support projects for client accounts such as John Deere. 
-- JavaScript, Java, Spring Framework, SQL, Flyway migration
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework (EF) Core · Spring Framework · SQL · Flyway · C# · Microsoft Azure · Azure Active Directory · JavaScript · Java · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Verification Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed as the sole software quality member of a small Agile team working towards FDA 510(k) submission for intraoral X-ray imaging system. Short term contract through AeroTek.
- Planned software verification strategy and established unit test framework (C#, MSTest)
- Performed manual software testing, project documentation reviews.
- Generated software verification test procedure and test plans in accordance with IEC 62304.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the Cardiovascular Imaging Pacs Project as part of the QA Initiatives team. 
- Acted as the on-site developer for the application’s Coded UI test suite. 
- Developed the majority manual deployment pipeline towards an automated, continuous project model by scripting silent installations of various assemblies using PowerShell.
- Established Agile rituals and other practices in a team whose members had limited prior Agile experience by serving as acting Scrum Master/Couch.
- Transitioned to Synapse 5 Medical Informatics suite of products as a QA Scrum tester, System Test writer and Internal Audit team member (ISO/FDA). Developed and tested with medical imaging and diagnostic review software, PACS/RIS systems and workflows, HL7, DICOM and other related medical imaging standards and protocols.
- Proposed, lead and implemented numerous team initiatives to find bugs, validate performance and security, improve inter- and intra-team communications, upgrade test tools and more.
- System Test writer on Artificial Intelligence Platform Project. Tested the RESTful API (within a .NET framework) that would allow access for third-party AI engines to patient data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Integral part of team to soft launch a new e-commerce website for collectibles and auctions. Worked in a Scrum environment with technically skilled team members to develop website features used by both buyers and sellers for finding products, purchasing products, viewing order history, and more.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Began on iGovern project – Child Care Benefits for the State of Massachusetts. Responsibilities included Java/Javascript defect fixing, security implementation and general code maintenance.

•	Beginning Nov 2012, joined large State government website project for the Virginia Employment Commission. My performance lead to increased responsibilities, including: 
o	Module development based on use cases and extensions, 
o	Business Intelligence and Reporting Tools (BIRT) report creation and publishing, 
o	EngageOne correspondence maintenance and publishing. 
o	Earned responsibility to maintain environment build for 15+ developers and testers. 
o	Volunteered to provide daily and baseline environment building, deployment and maintenance using Hudson (a continuous integration tool).

•	Beginning Jan 2014, worked with strong development team on project for Wyoming, Colorado, Arizona, North Dakota consortium (WyCAN) – iGOVERN project. Responsibilities included:
o	Application front-end through database back-end code development based on client generated storyboards and extensions. 
o	Trained incoming team members on development environment and code base.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched the difference in performance of an artificial intelligence system, comparing runs on a single-threaded CPU (central processing unit), multi-threaded CPU, and massively-multi-threaded graphics processing unit (video card).

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Returned for third internship: Worked at Talecris Plasma Resources Corporate Headquarters in the Project Management Organization. Constructed and standardized key performance indicator reports and corresponding submission procedure. Also worked independently on a tracking database for project rollouts across the entire company (40+ sites).

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Returned for second internship: Worked in PCS (Process Control Systems) Project Engineering Department. Created step-by-step procedures for the installation and operation of fiber optic cabling and servo drives.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Summer internship: Worked in the PCS Maintenance Department. Created a database that would contain parts and specifications of all the power distribution equipment in the manufacturing plant.
